premise: After 27 years as a school bus driver, I used my $127,000 pension to buy a fleet of pressure-washing rigs and a parking-lot striping route with my nephew, notarizing 50/50 and a lifetime of free driveway sealing for my widowed neighbors, but he registered the business under his girlfriend's name, sold the contracts for $560,000, and handed me a $3,800 'soap' check; I found a voicemail where he admitted the whole scam, got a judgment, and now run 'Washout of Deceit Pressure Cleaning,' where he scrubs dumpster pads in a wetsuit that says 'Striped My Pension' and every invoice prints his fraud docket.
